methodUpgrade.title: Methodology and data sources
methodUpgrade.sourceBody: Fixtures, results, standings, form and available statistics from API-Football.
methodUpgrade.modelBody: Poisson with Dixon–Coles adjustment, home advantage, recent form and attacking/defensive performance.
methodUpgrade.limitationsBody: We do not use unverified information. Absences appear only when reliable data is available.
methodUpgrade.caveat: Probabilities are estimates, not certainties. Accuracy History shows successes, failures and calibration.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.section1Body: Skorama is a statistical analysis tool for football matches, based on a mathematical model (Poisson with a Dixon-Coles adjustment). It is not a betting service and does not provide "sure" predictions or guaranteed profits. The probabilities shown are the result of statistical calculations on historical data and may not come true.
terms.section2Body: We offer a Free plan (limited access) and a Pro plan (full access, paid, via Stripe). The Pro subscription renews automatically on a monthly basis unless cancelled. You can cancel at any time from your account page — Pro access remains active until the end of the current billing period, with no partial refund for the remaining time.
terms.section3Body: Comments on matches, reviews, and suggestions you post are your own responsibility. We reserve the right to remove content that is offensive, illegal, or off-topic.
terms.section4Body: Skorama is provided "as is". We are not responsible for decisions (financial or otherwise) you make based on the model's predictions. If you use this information in combination with betting, you do so entirely at your own risk and in accordance with the laws applicable in your country.
terms.section5Body: These terms are governed by Greek law. The courts of Athens have jurisdiction.
